title: ROM Cat
whisper: the catalog that files the makers · and the makers' ROMs

producers.name: Dewey Catalog Co.
producers.mission: We file what the other makers make. We file ourselves. Quaint library systems for lists that matter.
producers.notes: First ROM sets the house look. Keep the sticky cabinet (cat-o-roms) as a separate cute accident — not this catalog.

producers.name: Charlie's Toys
producers.mission: Time machines, import saws, slightly illegal fun.

producers.name: World Builder Studios
producers.mission: Inhabit-able world builders. Stages you walk into.

producers.name: Chester's Imports
producers.mission: The shop. Terminals leak from severed loops. Not a studio.

producers.name: Something Mattered Here
producers.mission: Something mattered here. That's the whole thesis.

producers.name: BAR-B Games
producers.mission: Barb B Vale's Game ROMs. Mystical toys for mystical dolls.

producers.name: KDE Fugue Inc.
producers.mission: Strange looping pocket machines and amnesia detectives. Slot-keyboard narrative toys (Notes & Chords). Cases that drip. A detective that cannot remember keeps investigating the same shit. Chaos with a K.
producers.notes: Merged CO.FIN (Fugue Inc.) into CO.KDE. One house: looping pocket games + fugue detectives. Physical toys may still live under charlies-toys until a company island exists.

producers.name: My Pocket Things
producers.mission: Pocket apps for one kind of clay. Not terminals. Not global software. Chapbooks, and whatever else fits in a pocket later.
producers.notes: First SKU: chapbook maker. Teenage zine energy — heavy poetry, not kawaii.

producers.name: Jack's Cross
producers.mission: Concordance desk and Cab into jx papers.

roms.name: ROM Cat
roms.description: Catalog of ROM producers and their SKUs. SKU is a ROM chip code. Lists itself.

roms.name: cat-o-roms (sticky face)
roms.description: Cute crooked sticky drawer. Not the yellow pages. Keep; do not destroy; do not pretend it is Fry's.
roms.notes: Accidental art object. May rehome as meaningless sticky-notes ROM later.

roms.name: Terminal Prolog
roms.description: YOU ARE SOMEWHERE. That is all there is to know. Can you even think anymore?
roms.notes: Recover old PY pre-build on ROM from mausoleum

roms.name: The Forgetting House
roms.description: You keep resetting. Again and again. Something mattered here, but what? Can you put the memories back together while you keep forgetting?

roms.name: Morana Arcana
roms.description: A tarot app. Of a sort. Load decks. Pull cards. Find meaning in the BARBs.

roms.name: My PI: Kitten Detective Chapter I
roms.description: A strange town. A detective who can't remember her own name. The cases keep looping. Can the mystery be found between the lines?

roms.name: KDE Notes & Chords
roms.description: Instrumental Stories / KDE Notes & Chords: one row of 15 keys. Match plays chord from strip positions. Narrative fragments, not cash prizes.
roms.notes: Producer CO.KDE (not CO.TOY). Path under charlies-toys is temporary housing. UI: ONE horizontal strip (musical sheet), not a casino 5x3 grid.

roms.name: My Pocket Chapbook
roms.description: Poem pool + chapbooks with sections. Reorder page-sheets to tell the story. Pocket press, not a terminal.
roms.notes: DCO REQ SKU 001-CHAPS. Empty shells for Ocean Cried Blood / Body Is a Water.

roms.name: ROM Launcher
roms.description: Start menu for ROMs. Primary Deck Host face. Cases on a desk. Quiet launch.
roms.notes: Reads ROM Cat; launcher_show toggle; recipes in launches.json
